mapper.select: SELECT user_id FROM jiedan_project_tester WHERE order_id=#{orderId} ORDER BY user_id

SELECT u.user_name FROM sys_user u JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id=u.user_id JOIN sys_role r ON r.role_id=ur.role_id WHERE u.user_id=#{userId} AND u.status='0' AND u.del_flag='0' AND r.role_key='customer' AND r.status='0' AND r.del_flag='0' LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM jiedan_project_tester WHERE order_id=#{orderId} AND user_id=#{userId}
DELETE pt FROM jiedan_project_tester pt JOIN jiedan_order o ON o.id=pt.order_id WHERE pt.user_id=#{userId} OR o.customer_account=#{account}
